senses.gloss: הוֹנָה (b. h.; v. אָנָה) to oppress, treat overbearingly, vex, taunt.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 88">Gen. R. s. 88</cite>, beg. <he>שלא יהו מוֹנִים את וכ׳</he> that they might not taunt Israel saying &c.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:6">Cant. R. to I, 6</cite>. Tanḥ. Vayera 14 <he>כל מי שיוֹנֶה להבירו</he> whoever aggrieves his neighbor.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:6">Ib.</cite> <he>הוֹנֵת את עצמה</he> humbled herself; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="E00249"><he>הוֹנָאָה</he></cite>, <cite ref="A00722"><he>אוֹנָאָה</he></cite>.
